name: orbital-signal
description: libsignal bindings for Orbital-Mobile via uniffi-bindgen-react-native
author: Pure Karma Labs

scripts.comment:marker: build:ios[:release] write the marker via scripts/write-rust-marker-ios.sh (rationale, incl. the deliberate pre-build rm -f, lives in its header).
scripts.build:ios: rm -f rust-profile-ios.txt rust-profile-ios.txt.tmp && ubrn build ios --config ubrn.config.yaml --and-generate && bash ../../scripts/write-rust-marker-ios.sh debug
scripts.build:ios:release: rm -f rust-profile-ios.txt rust-profile-ios.txt.tmp && ubrn build ios --config ubrn.config.yaml --release --and-generate && bash ../../scripts/write-rust-marker-ios.sh release
scripts.build:android: rm -f android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt && ubrn build android --config ubrn.config.yaml --and-generate && echo debug > android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt
scripts.build:android:release: rm -f android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt && ubrn build android --config ubrn.config.yaml --release --and-generate && echo release > android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt
